description: This file defines the AporiaGuardrail class, which extends CustomGuardrail to implement guardrail functionalities using Aporia AI for LLM moderation and validation within a FastAPI-based project. It includes methods for message transformation, preparing requests, making API calls to Aporia, and handling post-call moderation and hooks.

classes.name: AporiaGuardrail
classes.description: A class that extends CustomGuardrail to implement guardrail logic using Aporia AI for message validation, moderation hooks, and request handling.
